name: print-social-action-plan-poster-pink-with-lightbulb-and-sticky-notes-photo
title: 'Action Plan' creative agency poster with a real photo of a lightbulb on scattered pink sticky notes
whatItIs: A hot pink poster with a hexagon logo, bold 'ACTION PLAN' and 'Creative Marketing Agency' subtitle, body copy, a 'Digital Positioning' label with social icons, geometric pink colour blocks in the corner, and a real photograph of a lightbulb resting on fanned pink and lilac sticky notes with crumpled paper balls.
whatItMeans: Tactile and idea-driven; a real photographed lightbulb-on-notes scene grounds an abstract 'action plan' in something physical.
techniques: Photograph a symbolic object (a lightbulb) on real sticky notes.
Mix flat geometric blocks with real photography in one layout.
Use crumpled paper as a texture suggesting brainstorming.

vocabulary.definition: A staged photo where an object represents an abstract idea.
A geometric shape anchoring one corner of a layout.
